# Site Title

<!-- START TOKEN(Autogenerated block API docs) -->
**Name:** `core/site-title`
**Category:** [theme](/docs/reference-guides/core-blocks/category-theme.md)
**API Version:** [3](/docs/reference-guides/block-api/block-api-versions/)
**Block Type:** [Dynamic](/docs/getting-started/fundamentals/static-dynamic-rendering.md) (server-rendered)

> Displays the name of this site. Update the block, and the changes apply everywhere it’s used. This will also appear in the browser title bar and in search results.

## Attributes

_Defined via the [`attributes`](/docs/reference-guides/block-api/block-attributes.md) property in block.json._

| Attribute | [Type](/docs/reference-guides/block-api/block-attributes.md#type-validation) | [Default](/docs/reference-guides/block-api/block-attributes.md#default-value) | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `level` | `number` | `1` | — |
| `levelOptions` | `array` | `[0,1,2,3,4,5,6]` | — |
| `isLink` | `boolean` | `true` | [Role](/docs/reference-guides/block-api/block-attributes.md#role): `content` |
| `linkTarget` | `string` | `"_self"` | [Role](/docs/reference-guides/block-api/block-attributes.md#role): `content` |

## Block Markup

This is a [**dynamic block**](/docs/getting-started/fundamentals/static-dynamic-rendering.md). It is rendered on the server and does not save HTML in post content.

In post content, it is stored as a block comment:

```html
<!-- wp:site-title {"level":1,"levelOptions":[0,1,2,3,4,5,6],"isLink":true,"linkTarget":"_self"} /-->
```
